items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: Now I had correspondence with A.J. Perron.

ctx.x: Now, what about Lytel and Signorelli and their recording of Sister Kate?

They took the whole arrangement in total and recorded it. That's what they did. And they made Sister Kate. Now I had correspondence with A.J. Perron. I just can't find it at present. I would like to include that in there to show you that Perron and I correspond before Francis Williams ever came to New York.
Before who was this came to be?
